[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172466/d372d43c671585b38f85d0a5d9e9434103096ef6.jpg"][/img][i]Omuro Cave looks a bit different.

notes.title: Afterlife Reverie+ is on the way.
notes.content:
[p]Under the tentative title Afterlife Reverie+, I'm working on a decently sized update for the game, aiming to release it in time for the game's first anniversary in late November.

The current scope of the update is to comprehensively redo all the cutscenes now that I kinda know how to draw, and improve some technical aspects of the game such as having it internally render at 1080p as opposed to 576p. Moment-to-moment gameplay is also seeing some improvements in feel and function.

As for new content, there's nothing concrete as of yet but at least one new level is likely, and I'm open to suggestions so long as they're within the scope of the update.

I anticipate this will be the final major update for the game, I've been having a lot of fun learning to draw and this will be a good test of my year's progress so far, but I'm eager to get onto a new game after this. The Seija fangame I was working on had some decent progress but I'm not enthused to finish it. That being said, many breakthroughs I had developing it are being implemented into AR+.

This game's codebase is absolute spaghetti. I want to go back in time and strangle the idiot that wrote all this. But to the best of my ability, AR+ will finally realise the game's full potential.

Anyway, the game's on sale right now for 80% off. The game's price won't increase when AR+ drops but the sales will likely be a mite stingier, so this is certainly the best time to pick the game up.

Catch you later, lads.

Signed, Raven.

(Follow me on Twitter at @HellRavenLover btw, I do draw some gorgeous anime girl baps)[/p]

notes.title: Teach Me, Otonoji-San! - Afterlife Reverie v1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The long-awaited v1.2 update is finally here, alongside a 40% discount! I anticipate this will be the final major update to the game, given that I would like to move onto other projects, but at a staggering 46 levels, I think I've left a feature-complete game in my wake. If you enjoy the game, I encourage you to spread the word to friends, and what better time than during a sale?

v1.2
Teach Me, Otonoji-San! Update
- 3 New EX Levels added where Otonoji teaches you about advanced techniques after beating the game.
- 7 New EX Levels accessible after beating the previous 3, each with an additional requirement to unlock.
-- All EX Levels include new accessories for collected Scraps and S Ranks.
- 8 new achievements added to Steam
- EX Levels' selection boxes now change colour based on their completion status.
-- Torquise if their scrap has been collected.
-- Purple if their S Rank has been achieved.
-- Gold if both conditions are true.
- Reduced the size of the Wardrobe's selection boxes to account for the ever increasing maximum capacity.
- The game UI's transparency is reduced during Freecam mode, to improve level readability.
- Crows now have a collision box so they don't all blend into the same position, attacking as a real murder now.
- Some code related to the blue platforms now runs per physics tick rather than per rendered frame.
- Yomi now correctly leaves the level with the black mirror if she hits it during Lily status.
- Changes/improvement to certain interactions to accommodate the EX Levels.
-- Prevented taking new transformations while already transformed, for ones that didn't previously share a level.
-- Hunting Children are now sent fleeing if struck by an Angel's spear.

Thanks for playing,
    Raven.

notes.title: Afterlife Reverie Devlog 11/01/25
notes.content:
Ohayo.

Let's get straight to the point, I'm working on some new levels for the game.

I fully intended to move straight onto another big project and maybe dot a handful of new levels in to AR here and there but I'm struggling to come up with something new to work on. Until that next idea solidifies in my head, I'll simply keep adding to this game.

The sales have expectedly been on the lower end but those who have played it have left some glowing reviews. Every one is appreciated.

So what can you expect in the near future?

- New "Teach Me, Otonoji-san!" EX levels designed to teach the player advanced techniques and exploits.
-- These will be unlocked upon beating the final level of World 7.
- Other EX levels unlocked from various milestones and points of progression, varying in length and difficulty.
- All EX levels also contain a unique clothing item for both S Ranking and collecting its scrap.
- Perhaps some other fixes and quality of life improvements.

Other things that [i]may[/i] be added but aren't promises:
- Custom input mapping
- New achievements
- Graphical improvements

All of this will be released in a v1.2 patch, to coincide with the game's next sale period.

Speaking of which, the game is currently 25% off on Steam.

If you still don't own the game or want to send it to a friend, now's a good time to grab it!

No price increases or paid DLC are planned for future updates.

notes.title: Afterlife Reverie v1.1 - The Belt Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172466/cfccaf3beacf3c3691d63fa023e148daf42c01e6.png[/img]

The first content update for Afterlife Reverie has arrived! A new category of clothing has been added, and a new level can be accessed after clearing the first two worlds of the game!

v1.1 patch notes:
- The player is now awarded belts based on the current save's Total Combined Time.
-- Belts start being awarded once the time drops below an hour, up until sub-15 minutes is reached.
-- Izanami has 3 new interactions referencing this new system.
-- While wearing a belt, [spoiler]a level's rank times are now shown after clearing it.[/spoiler]
--- [spoiler]The values are sometimes one-onehundredth lower than they are written internally. Not sure why.[/spoiler]
- The clothes awarding code has been altered to check your save doesn't already possess the incoming clothes.
-- I don't think any duplication glitches still exist but this protects against any that may have slipped by and allows me to be more flexible in how the game awards clothes.
- EX Level system has been implemented.
-- Currently only 1 EX level has been added, Christmas in the Palace.
-- EX Levels don't contribute to game progression and leaderboard times but do contain unique clothing items.
- Fixed Save 3's stars showing based on Save 1's data rather than its own.
- Restored the save screen's functionality of showing a 4th star for collecting all 35 [spoiler]SS Ranks.[/spoiler]
- Fixed an issue where dialogue with Izanami unlocked by obtaining all S ranks and obtaining all [spoiler]SS Ranks[/spoiler] would have instead played her first conversation.
- Removed mouse-interactive scrollbar from menus where it showed up.
- Changes to Switches and Doors' coding to make them independent from level scripting.
- Fixed a crash that happens if the Wardrobe category changes during a scene transition.
- Fixed a rare crash related to Yomi's afterimages.
- Level times don't show above doors until that level has been completed.

Edit:
This evening, I also pushed an update for the Demo. It brings its content up to quality parity with the main game. If you have any friends on the fence about the game, let them know!

notes.title: 100 Wishlists! + Quick Update
notes.content:
The title is rather self-explanatory: With the help of the game's amazing players and testers, we've reached the monumental milestone of 100 wishlists!

Between a concerted effort to improve my artist skills and a few bouts of illness, I've gotten less done on the game last month than I would have liked, but as a product of the former I can at least celebrate the occasion.

https://x.com/HellRavenLover/status/1853133141386367178
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172466/ab175bd445c78d71bd6295f82e1dbc82ebc9ab73.png[/img]

Once again, thanks to anybody who's played the demo, playtested the game or helped get the word out in any way.

As for the condition of the game, despite the slowed progress of last month, I'm confident a release by year's end is still possible. The demo will remain available until at least the game's full release; whether it stays up after that depends on how much the final game differs from it in certain aspects.

The game is almost entirely content complete, with just 4 levels left to create; most work on it now pertains to graphics and art assets. I'll make sure to get a lot more done for the rest of the year than in October, and hope to deliver a good final product.

The game's expected pricing remains unchanged, and its post-launch future is still undecided; if certain extra content or cut features do make a return, it'll likely be as one big future update rather than a trickle of small additions.

Yet again, I'm incredibly grateful for all the support shown. If you want to help in any way, Follow the game on Steam and share the game's posts on my Twitter page: https://x.com/HellRavenLover


Yay, peace peace,
Raven.

notes.title: Demo incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Have a taste of the Underworld on October 14th![/h1]

Afterlife Reverie will receive a demo in October to coincide with Steam Next Fest. What can you expect in the demo? Find out right here:

[h2]Demo Features:[/h2]
- 10 of the 35 levels available.
- Ranking and collectible systems.
- Wardrobe feature to dress the main character.
- The first handful of story cutscenes to introduce our main character and her struggle.
- Conversations with Izanami.

[h2]What will not be included in the demo?[/h2]
- Leaderboard system.
- Bonus features (silly stuff like screen filters or comedic effects).
- Gallery (for game art and the like).

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

Q: Will saves from the demo be compatible with the full game?
A: No. The save system requires significant rewriting but this will be saved for closer to the game's launch. The levels, their requirements and the rewards from each should stay intact, however.

Q: What is subject to change?
A: Mostly things related to backend coding and graphics. Within the demo, what will likely see significant change in the final game is the Wardrobe interface. It's currently functional for the scope of the demo but risks being untenable as the game adds more and more items to wear in the full game.

Q: Where can I find out more about the game's development?
A: I post regularly about the game on Twitter (currently called X for some reason), and post less regularly on Youtube, though the latter tends to be more substantive and long-form. Links to both can be found on the store page.

Q: What is the projected release date of the full game?
A: This depends on how busy October is for me but currently, the end of November or beginning of December looks feasible. Pushing into Q1 2025 isn't out of the question entirely but it's looking unlikely at the moment.

Q: What are the plans for post-launch updates?
A: Nothing set in stone aside from patching any serious issues that arise. New levels are possible but as much as I'd like it, a level editor is more than likely impossible without completely rewriting the entire game in multiple areas.

Thank you for reading, if you haven't already please do follow and wishlist the game, every bit of interaction goes a long way. Take care.
